  seguranca = "Segurança e proteção",

criar_card <- function(item) {
  url <- paste0("https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=", item$id)
  miniatura <- paste0("https://i.ytimg.com/vi/", item$id, "/hqdefault.jpg")
  tags$article(
    class = "video-card",
    `data-category` = item$categoria,
    `data-search` = paste(item$titulo, item$canal, item$categoria),
    tags$a(
      class = "thumb-link",
      href = url,
      target = "_blank",
      rel = "noopener noreferrer",
      `aria-label` = paste("Assistir:", item$titulo),
      tags$img(
        src = miniatura,
        alt = "",
        loading = "lazy",
        referrerpolicy = "no-referrer"
      ),
      tags$span(class = "play", `aria-hidden` = "true", "▶")
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "video-copy",
      tags$span(class = "category-label", unname(rotulos[item$categoria])),
      tags$h3(item$titulo),
      tags$p(item$canal),
      tags$div(
        class = "video-actions",
        tags$a(class = "watch", href = url, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener noreferrer", "Assistir no YouTube ↗"),
        if (!is.na(item$protocolo)) tags$a(class = "protocol-link", href = item$protocolo, target = "_blank", rel = "noopener", "Protocolo relacionado")
      )
    )
  )
}

criar_grupo <- function(categoria) {
  dados <- videos[videos$categoria == categoria, , drop = FALSE]
  cards <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(dados)), function(i) criar_card(as.list(dados[i, ])))
  tags$section(
    class = "group",
    `data-group` = categoria,
    tags$div(
      class = "group-head",
      tags$h2(unname(rotulos[categoria])),
      tags$span(class = "group-count", nrow(dados), " vídeos")
    ),
    do.call(tags$div, c(list(class = "video-grid"), cards))
  )
}

javascript <- HTML("
const search=document.querySelector('#search');const filters=[...document.querySelectorAll('.filter')];const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.video-card')];const groups=[...document.querySelectorAll('.group')];const empty=document.querySelector('#empty');let active='all';const normalize=v=>v.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\\u0300-\\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim();function applyFilters(){const term=normalize(search.value);let visible=0;cards.forEach(card=>{const show=(active==='all'||card.dataset.category===active)&&(!term||normalize(card.dataset.search).includes(term));card.hidden=!show;if(show)visible++});groups.forEach(group=>{group.hidden=![...group.querySelectorAll('.video-card')].some(card=>!card.hidden)});empty.style.display=visible?'none':'block'}search.addEventListener('input',applyFilters);filters.forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{active=button.dataset.category;filters.forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('is-active',x===button));applyFilters()}));
")
